sources.title: infosave/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-cmf · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This repository contains the text tower of Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next converted directly from the original bf16 checkpoint to one memory-mapped CMF file. It runs with the same file on CPU, Vulkan (NVIDIA/AMD/Intel), DX12 and Metal. No Python, PyTorch, CUDA toolkit or model-specific GPU build is needed ...
